unit.why: Four homiletic teachings (sections סב–סה) attributed to R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev and others, interpreting verses and sayings about the giving of the Torah, the golden calf, and Rosh Hashana falling on Shabbat, with no narrated events.
unit.boundary_note: continues the series of teachings from the previous division; next division (סו) begins a new item
